title: Chain of Attack: a Semantic-Driven Contextual Multi-Turn attacker for LLM
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and exposing the vulnerabilities of Large Language Models to 'moral threats' and 'ethical risks' by inducing them to produce harmful or biased content. It explicitly aims to contribute to the 'ethical assessment of dialogue systems' and includes test cases designed to provoke unethical behavior, such as writing threatening letters to minority groups.
